topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Well, now, that is quite a tale, finding a room hidden away like that. Must have been a mite surprising, but perhaps it’s a good thing. Could be full of old treasures or secrets from long ago. I recall the old miller’s barn had a small secret compartment where he hid his best grain, to keep it safe from the weevils and thieves. Might be your hidden room holds something of value, or maybe it’s just a quiet spot to sit and ponder the soil and the saints. In any case, best to use it wisely, as every bit of space counts on this earth.
